title: Qualify finite bracketed root solving and composite Simpson quadrature
commitMessage: feat: add bounded univariate root and Simpson integration contracts

contribution.summary: Qualify provider-free bounded real bisection and composite Simpson with truthful residual, bracket and heuristic error diagnostics. Recover one compiled RED; pass 43 independent GREEN, 48 retained T1 and 60 T2 curve tests plus two relevant Math regressions. SHA-inspect an actual preview.3 local NuGet and run eight source-free scientific probes. Complete only C02-T1 R/G/V; leave C02, W01/M6 and public or foreign adoption open.
contribution.value: Deliver useful, bounded numerical root and quadrature primitives without silently certifying continuity, root error, integral error, unknown units or user callbacks. Retain qualified curve APIs and independent package verification.
debtChanges: Treat finite opposite endpoint signs as an input bracket only; caller continuity and uniqueness remain unverified assumptions.
Keep the Simpson refinement difference /15 as an explicitly noncertified smooth-case estimate, never a rigorous global error bound.
Observe one compiled reflection RED for missing bounded root/quadrature public API before staging source.
Require 43 new GREEN and the recovered RED plus 48 qualified C01 T1 and 60 C01 T2 tests.
Bound bisection iterations and Simpson panel/evaluation budgets; represent callback errors, NaN, missing bracket, cancellation and failure as typed nonpartial refusals.
Repack versioned net10 BCL-only analysis 1.1.0-preview.3; inspect actual local archive identity and digest with a separate helper.
Restore a source-free pinned consumer from the isolated local NuGet feed; verify eight independent numerical and refusal probes against the same SHA-256.
Close C02-T1 R/G/V and T1 only; preserve C02-T2 and later M6 tasks, public NuGet, cross-platform and Decision/MCDM adoption as unqualified.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS083 success, prepare RS084 M6-W01-C02-T2 for discontinuity/tolerance and failure-budget falsification; close C02 only upon its independent qualification. No public package.

achievements.achievement: Observe one genuine compiled missing-public-API RED for independent bounded root and Simpson operations before introducing product source.
Implement provider-free finite bisection and Simpson with explicit request policy, observed diagnostics and 43 independent GREEN scientific assertions.
Retain 108 C01 curve tests and two Math regressions, SHA-qualify preview.3 archive and pass eight independent NuGet-only consumer probes.
Qualify bounded univariate root/quadrature contract and independent package for C02 T1, leaving noncertified tolerances and C02 T2 gate explicit.
